# Field Notes — Travel Journal by Ulana Rey

> Field Notes is the travel journal of Ulana Rey — also styled Ulana Rey
> PharmD, Dr. Ulana Rey, or Ulana Rey, Doctor of Pharmacy — a San
> Francisco–based travel writer, photographer, biotech consultant, and
> healthcare executive, driven by AI and innovation.

## About the author

Ulana Rey, PharmD, is a Doctor of Pharmacy (University of California, San
Francisco; residency at Stanford University) and a clinical
pharmacist by training. She is a biotech and pharma consultant, healthcare
executive, entrepreneur, Founder & CEO of MindLumina, and owner of Ulana Rey
PharmD LLC. This journal collects her travel essays; her travel photography
portfolio is at https://ulanareyphotography.com.

## Canonical entity reference

The canonical biography of Ulana Rey, PharmD is:
https://mindlumina.com/about-ulana-rey/
